stem: Which condition is diabetes a risk factor for?
rationale: Microorganisms in the gut of ruminants and other herbivores can hydrolyze these bonds and ferment the products into short-chain fatty acids, which can impact metabolic health in at-risk individuals such as those with diabetes, obesity, or irritable bowel disease. By manipulating the microbial composition using prebiotics, one can shift the microbial population and possibly improve metabolic health.
